pendingNotices.title: Rapid Mobilization — units moved to base
pendingNotices.details: The Rebel player moved 1 unit from Tatooine into the hidden Rebel Base. The base itself did NOT move — Rapid Mobilization's other option (establish a new base) was not used, so no probe card changes hands and Tatooine remains a possible base location.

payload.reason: None of your units here can leave on their own — retreating needs a ship that can fly itself out (fighters, ground units and immobile units cannot).
Retreating means marching a leader out of the system, and you have no leader here — so these units have to stand and fight.
